title: Two City documents gave different deadlines for $1.17 million in Chinatown rent relief

beats.text: The Board gave a Chinatown tenant until September 30 to leave.

visual.sub: Two dates govern the same conditional rent relief

beats.text: The City’s notice gave it until the following night.

visual.kicker: Two dates govern the same conditional rent relief

beats.text: More than a million dollars in rent relief depended on that deadline.

visual.kicker: Two dates govern the same conditional rent relief

visual.label: The relocation offset used a different reporting period

beats.text: The notice used $345,000. The extra two months explain the difference.

visual.kicker: The relocation offset used a different reporting period

beats.text: That amount was to come off the tenant’s relocation payment.
The tenant had turned its banquet hall into a grocery.

visual.kicker: Planning approved temporary grocery use after a cancelled application

beats.text: Planning cancelled one application and approved temporary use five days later.

visual.kicker: Planning approved temporary grocery use after a cancelled application

beats.text: The City originally expected around 70 senior homes.

visual.label: The new project required additional land and a different schedule

beats.text: An adjoining parcel expanded the project to 175 units.

visual.label: The new project required additional land and a different schedule

beats.text: The July forecast moved completion to October 2029.
